Best for

  • Shops, showrooms, clinics and restaurants with false ceilings
  • Offices that want even airflow without wall units
  • Spaces where the indoor unit should be hidden from view

How to choose

  • Cassette ACs sit flush in the ceiling and spread air in several directions: good for open floors.
  • Concealed splits hide above the ceiling and feed air through ducts and grilles: good for a clean interior.
  • R410A models are the newer, ozone-friendly refrigerant; R22 models are also listed in the catalogue.
  • We size these from the floor area, ceiling height, glass and footfall during a site survey.

Questions about Hitachi Cassette & Concealed ACs

Not sure which model?

Tell us the room or building size and how you'll use it, and we'll recommend the right Hitachi system with a clear quote.

Call +91 94141 00877WhatsApp us
Cassette or concealed AC: which should I choose?

A cassette AC is visible as a ceiling panel and blows air in several directions, ideal for open shops and offices. A concealed AC is hidden above the ceiling and uses ducts, ideal when you want only grilles visible. We'll suggest the right one after seeing the space.

Do these ACs work in Jodhpur's summer heat?

Hitachi's concealed split range is listed to operate in outdoor temperatures up to 52°C, which covers Jodhpur's peak summer.

Do you handle the false-ceiling and ducting work?

We plan and install the AC, ducting, drainage and controls, and coordinate with your interior contractor for the ceiling.
